releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-greeting-refresh-error-rate = killswitch, enable-greeting-refresh-latency = pause, enable-greeting-refresh-success-rate = monitoring. Latency is two-armed (server-side render duration is emitted on both control and v1). The error and success metrics are one-armed by construction: control renders no refresh button, so only v1 can emit them. The project has no autogenerated otel* or $ld:telemetry:* metrics to use as global guardrails, and sentry-errors-* is backend-only, so track() is the only valid backing for this frontend flag. Caveat for the approver: the Flask backend sends no CORS headers, so a deployed browser blocks the greeting fetch and every refresh would report outcome=error into the killswitch metric.
